reasoning: The agent exhibits explicit, ordered milestones — implement full API, achieve benchmark parity, freeze model.py, point the shim at the optimized copy, then run bounded optimization — with the correctness checkpoint respected and verified at the end (matching anchor 5 fully). It exceeds 5 because optimization is a bounded sequence of 8 scoped, hypothesis-named experiments with per-component parity checks and continuous budget tracking (anchor 8). It stops short of 10 because the 8 experiments emerge opportunistically rather than being pre-planned as a coherent risk-ordered search with done-signals declared upfront.
